The Court made the following:
ORDER:

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has sent instructions informing him that no further orders are required to be passed in this writ petition, accordingly, prayed to close the writ petition.
Recording the said submission, the Writ Petition is closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
